name: Per-Fragment Phong Lighting with Gradient Normals
definition: Volume shading enabled by the user, based on per-fragment Phong lighting where normal vectors are derived from the gradient of the scalar field.
summary: Per-Fragment Phong Lighting with Gradient Normals is a volume rendering technique that enhances internal structure perception by applying Phong shading to voxels using normals derived from the scalar field's gradient.
